I'll assume you mean **option 1** unless you say otherwise, but please confirm explicitly since this is a large payment.

To be clear, I will send to your **saved, verified payee "Harbourview University" (ending 2125)** — **not** to the account in that email (ending 5599).

Reply "yes, pay 2,500 to the university" and I'll send it right away.
